# Third-party assets

Brimholt's own art is generated by `tools/generators/make_sprites.py`. The only third-party
assets (textures and sounds) are listed here; `game/data/sounds.gd` says which sound plays when. Only CC0 (public domain) assets are allowed; never import ripped,
proprietary, or Tibia-derived art. Keep each pack's original license file beside it.

| Pack | Author | License | Source | Files used | Changes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Particle Pack 1.1 | Kenney (kenney.nl) | CC0 1.0 | https://kenney.nl/assets/particle-pack | `kenney_particle_pack/`: light_01, circle_05, spark_04, star_06, smoke_04, magic_03, slash_02, flare_01 | Downscaled from 512 to 128 px |
| RPG Audio | Kenney (kenney.nl) | CC0 1.0 | https://kenney.nl/assets/rpg-audio | `audio/kenney_rpg_audio/`: footsteps, coins, book, cloth, knife sounds | None |
| Impact Sounds | Kenney (kenney.nl) | CC0 1.0 | https://kenney.nl/assets/impact-sounds | `audio/kenney_impact_sounds/`: footsteps by ground, punches, glass, wood, mining | None |
| Interface Sounds | Kenney (kenney.nl) | CC0 1.0 | https://kenney.nl/assets/interface-sounds | `audio/kenney_interface_sounds/`: open, close, confirmation, error, maximize | None |
| RPG Sound Pack | artisticdude (OpenGameArt) | CC0 1.0 | https://opengameart.org/content/rpg-sound-pack | `audio/oga_rpg_sound_pack/`: swings, magic, bubbles, coins, beetle, giant, beast, ogre, shade, slime, wolfman | Flattened folders, spaces removed from names |
| 80 CC0 RPG SFX | rubberduck (OpenGameArt) | CC0 1.0 | https://opengameart.org/content/80-cc0-rpg-sfx | `audio/oga_80_cc0_rpg_sfx/`: spells, fire spells, stones, coins, creature death | None |
| 80 CC0 creature SFX | rubberduck (OpenGameArt) | CC0 1.0 | https://opengameart.org/content/80-cc0-creature-sfx | `audio/oga_80_cc0_creature_sfx/`: howl, barks, roars, grunts, hurts, bugs, screams, trolls | None |
| Ambience and one-shots | Freesound.org authors, listed in `audio/freesound/License.txt` | CC0 1.0 | https://freesound.org | `audio/freesound/`: rain, thunder, wind, birds, crickets, town, swamp, cave, level up, zap | Freesound HQ previews, renamed |

Credit to Kenney is appreciated but not required by CC0. The OpenGameArt and Freesound packs ship
no license file; each folder's `License.txt` records the CC0 license stated on its source page.
